description: Embedded control system -- mission completion within a global deadline (two clocks). A global clock t always ticks; the mission uptime work advances only while the system is up, so an outage burns global time without progressing the mission. Can the controller (coalition) accumulate the required uptime (work >= mission) before the global deadline (t <= deadline)? Expected TRUE: by repairing it keeps the system operational every round, so work tracks t and the mission (which fits the horizon) completes in time. Discrete, qualitative analog of the PRISM time-bounded reliability property. Deadline and mission workload are arbitrary, not fixed in advance.
